canonical.description: DRAFT until the one-story sheet (backlog task 1) is approved: Vionlabs is entertainment-specific AI that understands what is inside every title (mood, scenes, characters, pacing) so streamers can personalise discovery, automate artwork and clips, and place ads in context.
canonical.founded: TO CONFIRM: vionlabs.com says 2016, Wikidata and LinkedIn say 2010

agentic_layer.what: An AI agent for editorial teams: describe a list, clip or thumbnail in plain language and get a finished result in minutes, for the team to review and approve.

agents.Curation Agent: ranks titles from across the catalog by relevance for seasonal line-ups and audience-specific collections
agents.Creative Agent: finds a scene from a description and cuts it in every ratio (16:9 TV, 1:1 feeds, 9:16 for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels); picks a frame and places the title's logo for thumbnails; imports finished assets into the editor

agentic_layer.built_on: Vionlabs media intelligence: multimodal embeddings and scene-level metadata, learned from 1,000,000+ analyzed assets; no manual tagging
agentic_layer.control: Nothing is published until someone on the team approves it
agentic_layer.proof: At a leading European broadcaster, a paid-social A/B test in April 2026 measured a 20.9% lower cost per conversion with Vionlabs-generated clips than with clips from an external agency
